question: Does frozen-specialist finite-sample conformal coverage routing retain old causal outcomes while detecting out-of-regime predictions and reviving on A-B-A without oracle inference labels?
hypothesis: Against strongest matched controls, an O(K) binary-outcome sidecar router using calibrations withheld from specialist fitting could achieve familiar-task Brier delta <=0.02, return <=12 observations, and no runaway speciation in 10% noise; no such guarantee follows from conformal marginal coverage.

frozen_design.task: binary public transition and terminal reward consequence streams; one separate router per outcome target
frozen_design.calibration_split: independent 128 labeled transitions per specialist, never used to fit that specialist or tune routes; precommit exact dataset hashes and identity disjointness before original-source scoring
frozen_design.nonconformity: binary 1-p(true label | public input), equivalent absolute residual for Bernoulli
frozen_design.quantile: k=ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); kth ordered calibration residual; infinity if k=n+1, no empirical reinterpretation
frozen_design.online_feedback: route before observing y; append membership only after publicly revealed outcome; W1/W8 feedback uses only prior outcomes
frozen_design.routing: empty current set or low trailing coverage => zero weight; otherwise smallest prediction-set cardinality then stable immutable module identifier; no oracle regime identifiers
frozen_design.speciation: only emit a signal after W consecutive universal abstentions; NEVER auto-spawn, freeze learner, mutate checkpoint or dispatch
frozen_design.negative_cases: identical experts, noisy/gradual shifts, cold restore/corrupt pin, replay duplication, absence of calibration holdout, no task-oracle access
frozen_design.data_budget: source-free deterministic unit fixtures only until owner source custody permits new training/calibration; prospective data budget unallocated
frozen_design.compute_budget: single Python stdlib per-step router, 1e5 synthetic operations for microtiming max; no paid API or external job
frozen_design.capacity: existing frozen modules only; sidecar thresholds and W<=8 booleans, no native model changes
frozen_design.evaluator: prequential transition and reward Brier per stage; same public inputs, actions and compute for strongest controls, no oracle regime labels

classification_rules.supported: fresh owner-qualified disjoint original source; all familiar Brier deltas <=0.02, per-stage matched new-task Brier <=0.195822 only if same cohort/scores and >=0.005 advantage over best per-stage equal-info control, revival <=12, majority stage wins and zero runaway speciation under both registered noise controls; independent Windows+Linux full exact-source final regression and reproduction
classification_rules.mixed: some preregistered criteria pass but at least one benefit or robustness gate fails
classification_rules.negative: any primary science gate fails with valid provenance or a conformal false abstention counterexample holds
classification_rules.invalid: calibration overlaps FIT or HELD, reused consumed outcomes as primary, missing checkpoint/runner custody, missing fully fitted controls, runtime feedback leakage, oracle task labels, shifted pre-frozen protocol or budget

statistical_limits: Inductive conformal finite-sample marginal validity requires exchangeability of calibration and test; it does not imply conditional accuracy, OOD detection, out-of-regime emptiness, or guaranteed A-B-A revival. W8 retrospective coverage threshold is heuristic and does not inherit conformal guarantees.
preregistration_note: This design-only commit precedes implementation and any CPR scoring. No new original cohort or independent calibration source has been frozen, so prospective scientific first-use is NOT authorized or classified PASS.
